map.由摩擦系数与流速求管道压降: Find the Pipe Pressure Drop from the Friction Factor and Velocity
map.输入摩擦系数 f、管长 L、管径 D、密度 ρ、流速 v，求压降。: Enter the friction factor f, pipe length L, diameter D, density ρ and velocity v to find the pressure drop.
map.算管道沿程损失: Compute the friction loss along a pipe
map.层流 f=64/Re；湍流用 Moody 图或 Colebrook 公式。: For laminar flow f=64/Re; for turbulent flow use the Moody chart or the Colebrook equation.
map.与局部损失？: How does it relate to minor losses?
map.叠加局部损失得总压降。: Add the minor losses on to get the total pressure drop.
map.达西-魏斯巴赫沿程压降（本页代码口径）：ΔP=f×(L÷D)×(ρ×v²÷2)（: Darcy–Weisbach friction pressure drop (as implemented here): ΔP=f×(L÷D)×(ρ×v²÷2) (Pa, f friction factor, L pipe length in m, D pipe diameter in m, ρ density in kg/m³, v velocity in m/s). Validation: blank input in any of the five fields prompts a message and stops. Criteria: no fixed grading; the drop is proportional to pipe length and the square of velocity and inversely proportional to diameter, so halving the velocity cuts the drop to a quarter, the main lever for pipe energy savings.
